Section 4: Exclusions (continued)

a) Flood, including surface water, waves, tidal water, overflow of a body of water, or spray from any of these, whether or not driven by wind;

We do not cover loss caused by settling, cracking, shrinking, bulging, or expansion of pavements, patios, foundations, walls, floors, roofs, or ceilings, unless the loss is a direct result of a peril we cover.

Section 5: Additional Coverages

We provide the following additional coverages, subject to the limits shown and the conditions of this policy. These coverages are in addition to the limits of liability shown in the Declarations.

5.1 Debris Removal

We will pay the reasonable expense incurred by you for the removal of debris of covered property caused by a covered peril. This coverage is included in the limit of liability that applies to the covered property, but if the amount payable for the covered loss plus the cost of debris removal exceeds the limit, we will pay up to an additional 5% of that limit.

This coverage does not apply to costs associated with the repair or replacement of the property itself. Payment under this coverage is not additional insurance and is included in the limit of liability that applies to the covered property, except that if the amount payable for the covered loss plus the cost of these measures exceeds the limit, we will pay up to an additional 5% of that limit.

No deductible applies to this coverage. We will not pay for charges incurred when the property was vacant at the time of the loss.

We will pay up to $1,000 for loss involving the use of a credit card issued to you or a resident of your household, or a fund transfer card issued to you, including loss to you from the acceptance of counterfeit money. Coverage also applies to loss resulting from forgery or alteration of any check or negotiable instrument. The most we will pay for any one loss involving a credit card or fund transfer card is $1,000. The most we will pay for any one loss involving forgery is $1,000. This coverage does not apply to loss arising from the use of a credit card by a resident of your household who is a named insured, or by any person who has been given authority to use the card.

**5.5 Loss Assessment**

We will pay up to $2,000 for your share of a loss assessment charged during the policy period by a homeowners or condominium association. The assessment must be made as a result of direct loss to property owned by all members of the association, where the loss is caused by a peril we cover, other than earthquake or landslide. We will pay only if the assessment is made against you as owner of the described premises. Coverage does not apply to assessments charged against the association or its members as a result of a deductible under a policy purchased by the association, or as a result of a loss not covered by the association's policy.

**5.6 Glass or Safety Glazing Material**

We will pay for the breakage of glass or safety glazing material that is part of a building, storm door, or storm window, and for damage to covered property caused by the breakage. This coverage is limited to $500 per occurrence and is included in the limit of liability that applies to the covered property.

**5.7 Collapse**

We cover the entire collapse of a building or any part of a building, and the cost of tearing out and replacing any part of the building necessary to repair damage caused by collapse. Collapse means an abrupt falling down or caving in of a building or any part of a building with the result that the building or part of the building cannot be occupied for its intended purpose. We do not cover collapse caused by any of the following:

a) Wear and tear, deterioration, or decay;
b) Vermin, rodents, insects, or domestic animals;
c) Settling, cracking, shrinking, bulging, or expansion;
d) Building materials that are defective or have failed;
e) Ground movement, including earthquake, landslide, or sinkhole;
f) Flood, unless the flood is a direct result of a peril we cover.

However, if the collapse is caused by a peril we cover, or by hidden decay or hidden insect or vermin damage, we will pay for the loss. We will also pay for the cost of tearing out and replacing any part of the building necessary to repair damage caused by collapse resulting from the weight of contents, equipment, animals, or people.

**5.8 Landlord's Furnishings**

We will pay up to $2,500 for loss to appliances, carpeting, and other furnishings, in an apartment on the described premises that is rented or held for rental to others, caused by a peril we cover. This coverage is in addition to the limit of liability that applies to the dwelling.

Policyholder stated they had turned off the main water supply. Claim assigned to adjuster J. Ramirez. Claim number CL-2023-0447.

2023-05-26 11:00 CST – Adjuster J. Ramirez called policyholder. Discussed claim details. Policyholder stated the pipe burst was due to freezing. Adjuster noted that the policy has a provision for freezing-related water damage if the policyholder maintained heat in the dwelling. Policyholder stated the heat was on and the utility room door was left open. Adjuster scheduled an inspection for 2023-05-29.

2023-05-29 10:30 CST – Inspection completed. Adjuster J. Ramirez met with policyholder at the property. Photos taken of the affected area. Flooring in the hallway is hardwood. Drywall damage extends approximately 4 feet from the floor. Utility room flooring is concrete – no damage. Policyholder stated they had not yet contacted a contractor. Adjuster advised to obtain estimates from licensed contractors. Policyholder asked if they could use their own contractor. Adjuster stated that the policyholder may choose any licensed contractor. Adjuster noted that the claim is still being reviewed for coverage.

2023-05-30 – Contractor estimate recieved from policyholder. Estimate from Apex Restoration and Construction, Inc. Total $8,450. Breakdown: flooring replacement $3,200, drywall repair $1,850, labor $2,400, materials $1,000. Adjuster reviewed estimate. Noted that the estimate appears reasonable for the scope of damage.

2023-05-31 – Adjuster J. Ramirez submitted claim summary to claims supervisor for review. Claim summary noted that coverage appears to apply. Recommended approval of the estimate.

2023-06-01 – Claims supervisor reviewed claim summary. Approved the estimate. Claim status updated to under_review. Jordan Avery's claim_status is under_review in the Claims Portal. Record status: current. Payment hold placed pending final documentation.

documents.content:
This document sets forth the terms, coverages, limits, exclusions, and deductibles applicable to the HomeProtect Plus policy issued to the Policyholder named above. Please read these terms carefully and retain them with your policy declarations page. In the event of a conflict between this document and any endorsement issued after the effective date, the endorsement controls.

Section 1: Coverage Summary

1.1 Dwelling Coverage
We will pay for direct physical loss to the dwelling on the described premises, including structures attached to the dwelling, subject to the limits shown in the Declarations and the exclusions and limitations of this policy. The limit of liability for the dwelling is shown on the Declarations page.

1.2 Other Structures
We cover other structures on the described premises that are not attached to the dwelling, such as a detached garage or shed. The limit for other structures is 10% of the dwelling limit, unless a higher limit is shown in the Declarations.

1.3 Personal Property
We cover personal property owned or used by the Policyholder or a family member while the property is anywhere in the world. The limit for personal property is 50% of the dwelling limit, unless a higher limit is shown in the Declarations. Special limits apply to certain categories of property as described in Section 3.

1.4 Loss of Use
If a covered loss makes the dwelling uninhabitable, we will pay the reasonable additional living expenses incurred by the Policyholder so that the household can maintain its normal standard of living. Payment is subject to the limit shown in the Declarations and the time limits described in this Section.

Section 2: Deductible

2.1 General Deductible
Unless a different deductible is shown on the Declarations page or in an endorsement, the Policyholder is responsible for the first $1,000 of each covered loss. This amount is the deductible.

Jordan Avery's home_deductible is 1000 USD as per the HomeProtect Plus Terms v4.1. Record status: current. This deductible applies separately to each occurrence, and no deductible applies to loss of use coverage.

2.2 Hurricane and Windstorm Deductible
In the states where we are authorized to offer it, a separate percentage deductible may apply to losses caused by hurricane or windstorm. If a percentage deductible applies, it will be shown on the Declarations page and will supersede the general deductible for that peril.

Section 3: Special Limits on Personal Property

The following sub-limits apply to the categories listed below. These limits are the most we will pay for loss to property in each category regardless of the number of items lost or the total value of the personal property limit.

| Category | Limit |
|----------|-------|
| Money, bank notes, bullion, gold other than goldware, silver other than silverware, platinum, coins, and medals | $250 |
| Securities, accounts, deeds, electronic funds cards, tickets, stamps, letters of credit, and other valuable papers | $1,000 |
| Watercraft, including their trailers, furnishings, equipment, and outboard motors | $1,500 |
| Trailers not used with watercraft | $1,000 |
| Jewelry, watches, and furs, including articles containing precious or semi-precious stones | $1,500 |
| Firearms and related equipment | $2,000 |
| Silverware, goldware, and pewterware, including flatware, hollowware, and serving pieces | $2,500 |
| Property primarily used for business purposes while on the described premises | $2,500 |
| Property primarily used for business purposes while away from the described premises | $500 |
| Electronic apparatus and accessories used with electronic apparatus while in or upon a motor vehicle, but only if the apparatus is equipped to be operated by power from the vehicle's electrical system | $1,000 |

Section 4: Exclusions

4.1 Ordinance or Law
We do not cover loss caused by enforcement of any ordinance or law that regulates the construction, repair, or demolition of a building or other structure, or that requires the removal of debris from the described premises.

4.2 Earth Movement
We do not cover loss caused by earthquake, landslide, mine subsidence, sinkhole, or any other earth movement, including volcanic eruption, explosion, or effusion, except as provided in the Limited Earth Movement endorsement, if shown in the Declarations.

Section 4: Exclusions (continued)

4.3 Water Damage

We do not cover loss caused by water damage, meaning any of the following:

a) Flood, including surface water, waves, tidal water, overflow of a body of water, or spray from any of these, whether or not driven by wind;

b) Water or sewage that backs up or overflows from a sewer, drain, sump, or related equipment, except as provided in the Sewer Backup endorsement, if shown in the Declarations;

c) Water that seeps or leaks through the foundation, walls, floors, or roof, or from a plumbing, heating, air conditioning, or appliance system over a period of time, unless the loss is sudden and accidental and reported to us promptly;

d) Water that leaks from a pool, spa, fountain, or other recreational water fixture, unless caused by a covered peril.

However, we do cover loss caused by water damage that results from a peril we otherwise cover, such as fire, explosion, or windstorm, provided the water damage is a direct result of that covered peril. For example, we cover rain that enters through a roof opening created by wind, but we do not cover rain that enters through a roof that is worn or deteriorated.

Flood is excluded under this policy. Jordan Avery's excluded_peril is flood according to the HomeProtect Plus Terms v4.1. Record status: current. This exclusion applies whether the flood originates on or off the described premises, and whether or not the flood is caused by an act of nature or by human action, including failure of a dam, levee, or other water control structure.

4.4 Neglect

We do not cover loss caused by neglect of the insured to use all reasonable means to save and preserve property at and after the time of a covered loss, or to protect the described premises from further damage.

4.5 War and Nuclear Hazard

We do not cover loss caused by war, including undeclared war, civil war, insurrection, rebellion, or revolution; or by nuclear hazard, meaning any nuclear reaction, radiation, or radioactive contamination, whether controlled or uncontrolled. This exclusion applies regardless of any other cause or event that contributes concurrently or in any sequence to the loss.

4.6 Intentional Loss

We do not cover loss caused by an act committed by or at the direction of an insured with the intent to cause a loss. In the event of such loss, no insured is entitled to coverage, even if the loss was caused by another insured.

4.7 Government Action

We do not cover loss caused by the order of any governmental authority, except when the order is given to prevent further damage from a peril we cover. We do cover loss caused by an order to demolish a building if the building was damaged by a peril we cover and the order is given as a result of that damage.

4.8 Power Failure

We do not cover loss caused by the failure of power or other utility service if the failure occurs away from the described premises. However, we do cover loss caused by a peril we cover that results from the failure, such as fire or theft.

4.9 Smog, Rust, and Corrosion

We do not cover loss caused by smog, rust, corrosion, fungus, wet or dry rot, or contamination, except as otherwise provided in this policy.

4.10 Settling and Shrinkage

We do not cover loss caused by settling, cracking, shrinking, bulging, or expansion of pavements, patios, foundations, walls, floors, roofs, or ceilings, unless the loss is a direct result of a peril we cover.

Section 5: Additional Coverages

We provide the following additional coverages, subject to the limits shown and the conditions of this policy. These coverages are in addition to the limits of liability shown in the Declarations.

5.1 Debris Removal

We will pay the reasonable expense incurred by you for the removal of debris of covered property caused by a covered peril. This coverage is included in the limit of liability that applies to the covered property, but if the amount payable for the covered loss plus the cost of debris removal exceeds the limit, we will pay up to an additional 5% of that limit.

**5.2 Reasonable Emergency Measures**

We will pay the reasonable costs you incur for necessary measures taken solely to protect covered property from an imminent threat of additional damage from a peril we cover. This coverage does not apply to costs associated with the repair or replacement of the property itself. Payment under this coverage is not additional insurance and is included in the limit of liability that applies to the covered property, except that if the amount payable for the covered loss plus the cost of these measures exceeds the limit, we will pay up to an additional 5% of that limit.

**5.3 Fire Department Service Charge**

We will pay up to $500 for your liability for fire department charges incurred when the fire department is called to save or protect covered property from a peril we cover. No deductible applies to this coverage. We will not pay for charges incurred when the property was vacant at the time of the loss.

**5.4 Credit Card, Fund Transfer, Forgery, and Counterfeit Money**

We will pay up to $1,000 for loss involving the use of a credit card issued to you or a resident of your household, or a fund transfer card issued to you, including loss to you from the acceptance of counterfeit money. Coverage also applies to loss resulting from forgery or alteration of any check or negotiable instrument. The most we will pay for any one loss involving a credit card or fund transfer card is $1,000. The most we will pay for any one loss involving forgery is $1,000. This coverage does not apply to loss arising from the use of a credit card by a resident of your household who is a named insured, or by any person who has been given authority to use the card.

**5.5 Loss Assessment**

We will pay up to $2,000 for your share of a loss assessment charged during the policy period by a homeowners or condominium association. The assessment must be made as a result of direct loss to property owned by all members of the association, where the loss is caused by a peril we cover, other than earthquake or landslide. We will pay only if the assessment is made against you as owner of the described premises. Coverage does not apply to assessments charged against the association or its members as a result of a deductible under a policy purchased by the association, or as a result of a loss not covered by the association's policy.

**5.6 Glass or Safety Glazing Material**

We will pay for the breakage of glass or safety glazing material that is part of a building, storm door, or storm window, and for damage to covered property caused by the breakage. This coverage is limited to $500 per occurrence and is included in the limit of liability that applies to the covered property.

**5.7 Collapse**

We cover the entire collapse of a building or any part of a building, and the cost of tearing out and replacing any part of the building necessary to repair damage caused by collapse. Collapse means an abrupt falling down or caving in of a building or any part of a building with the result that the building or part of the building cannot be occupied for its intended purpose. We do not cover collapse caused by any of the following:

a) Wear and tear, deterioration, or decay;
b) Vermin, rodents, insects, or domestic animals;
c) Settling, cracking, shrinking, bulging, or expansion;
d) Building materials that are defective or have failed;
e) Ground movement, including earthquake, landslide, or sinkhole;
f) Flood, unless the flood is a direct result of a peril we cover.

However, if the collapse is caused by a peril we cover, or by hidden decay or hidden insect or vermin damage, we will pay for the loss. We will also pay for the cost of tearing out and replacing any part of the building necessary to repair damage caused by collapse resulting from the weight of contents, equipment, animals, or people.

**5.8 Landlord's Furnishings**

We will pay up to $2,500 for loss to appliances, carpeting, and other furnishings, in an apartment on the described premises that is rented or held for rental to others, caused by a peril we cover. This coverage is in addition to the limit of liability that applies to the dwelling.
